# ponte_agent (Data Source)

One registered agent, by agent_id or by name. A name that matches no agent, or more than one, is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ponte_agent" "claims_bot" {
  name = "Claims Bot"
}

data "ponte_agent" "by_id" {
  agent_id = "agt_0123456789ab"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_id` (String) The agent id (agt_…). Set this or name.
- `name` (String) The agent's display name, matched exactly (case-insensitive). Set this or agent_id.

### Read-Only

- `framework` (String)
- `id` (String) The agent id.
- `labels` (Map of String) The labels policies match on.
- `status` (String) active, inactive, revoked or killed.
- `tools` (List of String) The agent's declared tools.
- `trust_tier` (String)
